# The Olea Group — Agent Recruiting (careers.myoleagroup.com)

Boutique bilingual brokerage based in Cape Coral, serving Lee, Hendry, Broward,
Miami-Dade, Sarasota, and Charlotte counties.

## Plans and fees — owner fact sheets, October 2026

- Independent agents can choose 100% commission. New agents can choose 70/30
  support for their first three residential sales, then move to 100% commission.
- $131.84 due at joining and monthly: $99 platform/license holding + $29 E&O
  insurance + 3% card processing. Not prorated; charged on the 1st thereafter.
- Residential sales: $499. Land: $299 below $100,000; $499 at/above $100,000.
  Administration, technology and five-year storage included. File review: $50.
  Agents inform buyers/sellers and arrange transaction fee payment at closing.
  Rental allocation is confirmed with the broker; no rental compliance review fee.
- Brokerage does not provide leads. Agents bring their own clients.
- Broker guidance on contracts and compliance is available on both plans.
  Office hours: Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM. Text urgent matters after hours.
- Optional bilingual 30-Day Agent Success Program: one-on-one mentorship,
  weekly lessons, assignments, accountability and completion certificate.
- Back-office transaction platform and mobile app, forms, templates, resource
  library, checklists, onboarding tutorials and sales production tracking.
- Association MLS and industry training; periodic office/Zoom workshops.
- Miami, Stellar and Gulf Coast MLS participation. Association/MLS dues are separate.
- 24/7 office access, meeting rooms, content room and client moving truck
  subject to scheduling and availability. E&O is part of the monthly pricing.
- Complimentary listing/branding exposure on request on a rotating basis.
  Agents pay their own marketing/branding expenses.
- Affiliated bilingual transaction coordinator team offers a low fee per transaction.
- Supplied system screenshots illustrate captured records, not live current inventory.
